author: ClubberNugget
body:
Anyone remember the zombie you could could click and it would then begin an orientation about avicus?

It would explain each gamemode and such.

I think this should be added again, when i first joined, i had no clue what on earth i was doing, but the zombie helped me out and i learned how to join a match and it made everything easy to understand.  I think this is a good idea to not only teach players the basics of avicus but it also advertises each gamemode equally, meaning its up to the player which one they think sounds the coolest, maybe it could increase play in other modes?

Anyway the main reason is to introduce new players to avicus in a nice and easy to understand way.

Opinions?

title: [Sug] bring tutorial back

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body: Yes please. An alternative as well, (If the zombie can't return) is to make a tutorial video and have a lobby message that redirects you to the video. Something short and simple so that new players can get the gist of things. I was actually going to start working on one xD, but we'll see what the developers think of this. I would think that KyloCode has that old code saved in some archives or something so if he was to add it back, he could do it in a snap.
